# SRS Envelope Schema v0.2.0

This version is an additive pre-release successor to v0.1.0. It preserves the existing required envelope and introduces a structured signature object plus named fields used by signed profiles. The v0.1.0 artifact remains byte-locked and unchanged.

Signed-receipt semantics are defined by `docs/profiles/SRS_SIGNED_RECEIPT_PROFILE_v0_1.md`. Profile-specific requirements are not inferred from the envelope schema alone.
